title: after an interrupted restore, the re-run said healthy while the site was down

findings.claim: after an interrupted restore the re-run of trialbox restore --restart started only the services it had stopped itself (H-100's F6): caddy, console and llm-verifier, left stopped by the interrupted run, stayed stopped and the site stayed down
findings.severity_basis: the site is not served after the documented way back from an interrupted restore, and the command says it is
findings.fix: --restart starts every service the box's compose defines (up -d --wait) and checks the full expected set; tools/trialbox/box_restore.py; tests/unit/test_restore_rerun_h126.py::test_a_rerun_after_a_signal_at_every_step_serves_the_site_or_says_it_does_not
findings.from: the integrator's red 7128848504 (the MVP walk's step 8 on a 16-service box, 7128827356), 2026-11-24

findings.claim: the restore's health line counted the services compose said ran (restarting and paused included) and compared the count with nothing: a shortfall ended 0 with "healthy: 13"
findings.severity_basis: an operator reads healthy while services are down
findings.fix: the line names the expected and the healthy count (16 of 16); a shortfall is exit 1 with the names; test_a_planted_stopped_or_unhealthy_service_fails_the_health_check
findings.from: the integrator's red 7128848504 (the MVP walk's step 8 on a 16-service box, 7128827356), 2026-11-24

findings.claim: a re-run that ended with the hold screening.after_restore held said nothing about the hold or what releases it
findings.severity_basis: the box makes no patient list and the command does not say so
findings.fix: after the start the command says the hold: released by the restore, or held until a person releases it on /ops/flags (RUNBOOK §5 step 4); test_a_rerun_after_a_signal_at_every_step_serves_the_site_or_says_it_does_not, test_the_hold_released_by_the_restore_is_said
findings.from: the integrator's red 7128848504 (the MVP walk's step 8 on a 16-service box, 7128827356), 2026-11-24

findings.claim: every restore after the first on a box stays held: the earlier restore's set-aside audit chain (_data.pre-restore-* in the audit volume) is never removed and backup.restore counts it as carried
findings.severity_basis: a person must release the hold after every later restore, even a complete one
findings.fix: not in this card: card H-129 (7132081597) takes it. D-522's rule as written (review H1). The host now says the hold and what releases it
findings.from: the integrator's red 7128848504 (the MVP walk's step 8 on a 16-service box, 7128827356), 2026-11-24

findings.claim: when the restore's container itself ends 130 after its data part (the walk's first run, complete: true), the host's line takes the end as unknown and says NOT as it was, do not start the services
findings.severity_basis: the first line overstates the damage; the re-run, now working, is the way back
findings.from: the integrator's red 7128848504 (the MVP walk's step 8 on a 16-service box, 7128827356), 2026-11-24

findings.claim: OCR 1470-1: a second Ctrl-C or SIGTERM while the stop or the start was being reported escaped the handler: no state line, no hold line, no audit event, a traceback
findings.severity_basis: the walk's own action is two Ctrl-C; the re-run still brought the box back
findings.fix: the audit event and the state line are said through BoxRestore._say: a second signal ends the asking, never the line ("not asked (interrupted again)"), the lines after it are said with signals ignored and put back; every state line of _after goes through it; test_a_second_signal_while_a_step_is_said_still_says_the_box_and_the_hold (6 cases)

findings.claim: OCR 1470-2: the whole-project start runs with compose's default pull policy, not --pull never as the update's start does (D-176)
findings.severity_basis: a service of an active profile whose image is not loaded makes the restore reach for a registry
findings.fix: the whole-project start takes --pull never, as the update's start (D-176), unless deploy/.env says TB_INSTALL_PULL=missing; never the caller's; test_the_start_pulls_as_the_box_file_says_never_by_default (4 cases)

findings.claim: OCR 1470-3: a shortfall after a held, NOT complete restore ended 1, not 4
findings.severity_basis: a script that reads 4 as restored and held loses NOT complete
findings.fix: a shortfall keeps the restore's own non-zero code (4 stays 4); a complete one ends 1; RUNBOOK §5 says so; test_a_shortfall_keeps_the_restores_own_code

findings.claim: OCR 1470-4: the comment over the start still said F6, the services this command stopped, and only those
findings.severity_basis: a reader is told the opposite of what the code does
findings.fix: the comment says H-126: every service the box defines, the full expected set checked

findings.claim: OCR 1470-5: the rehearsal's interrupted run was only echoed, not checked; a late signal still passed; a fail path left the background restore running
findings.severity_basis: the rehearsal could pass without having interrupted anything
findings.fix: live-restore polls every 0.2 s, fails when the run ended before the signal or ended other than 130 or 1, when it said healthy or did not say the box's state, and stops the background run on its fail path; test_the_rehearsal_reruns_an_interrupted_restore_and_the_site_answers

findings.claim: a signal between the restore container's end and the services' start (the host printing and reading its result) escaped as a traceback with no state line
findings.severity_basis: the rehearsal's signal lands at that moment; nothing said after a finished restore
findings.fix: BoxRestore._restore says the state through _say and ends 130; the invariant's step after-container (2 cases); found while fixing H126-10

findings.claim: LR-14 (the lifecycle review, on #1470 only): a re-run refused inside before any change (an old backup, another site, a wrong key) started the whole stack, including services an earlier restore left stopped on data that was NOT as it was, and said healthy N of N
findings.severity_basis: services start on half-restored data that the earlier run said not to start
findings.fix: after a restore refused before any change, --restart starts only what this run stopped (up --no-deps), checks those and db, and names the services it found stopped without starting them; test_lr14_a_rerun_refused_before_any_change_starts_only_what_it_stopped (fails at bb9a77b7)
findings.from: Lane LR's lifecycle deep review (docs/reviews/lifecycle-deep-review-2026-11-24.md, LR-14) and the integrator's 7136293245, 2026-11-24
